messages:
sam: Quick ping — noticed requests from Dedicated that lost org/project attribution and landed in the 'fallback' quota.

maria: oof. logging shows the auth-proxy returning 404 on origin assertion in the TLS handoff path :grimacing:

ash: any recent change to header sanitization rules? we added a pass-through flag for edge LB last week.

kevin: @ash I rolled a tweak to strip unknown headers for security. didn't think it would hit X-Redwood-Origin. can revert.

sam: here's a minimal repro: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'X-Redwood-Origin: org/1234;proj/alpha' https://api.redwood.internal/generate
```
response comes back fine but downstream svc sees no origin header.

maria: ops-bot trace shows proxy returning 204 from sanitization filter before routing. attaching trace id 8f3a.

ops-bot: trace 8f3a: auth-proxy -> sanitizer -> edge-lb -> runtime. sanitizer removed X-Redwood-Origin due to allowlist mismatch.

ash: yeah that's the new allowlist. I can update it to include X-Redwood-Origin and X-Request-Tag. any objections?

kevin: we need to be careful — adding headers to allowlist expands attack surface. Is there a way to sign the header instead and validate signature at runtime?

sam: signature would be ideal long-term. short-term, can we gate the header allowlist behind an emergency flag scoped to Dedicated only, so hosted customers unaffected?

maria: and we should add telemetry: a per-route metric for 'origin_lost' so console dashboards can alert on quota misattribution. current billing alerts miss these.

ash: agreed. I'll PR: add allowlist entry, add feature flag, and emit counter metric redwood.auth.origin_lost{route,env}. We'll also add a canary rollout to 5% of Dedicated.

kevin: also please add a temporary dashboard widget in Console under Routing -> Errors so SRE can monitor during canary.

sam: thanks. mtg at 20m to decide canary thresholds (error rate <0.5%, misattribution delta <0.2%).

maria: adding notes to the incident channel, linking traces.

ash: PR asap. ping here when live :thumbsup:
